title: 第67章 护身符自燃
content_zh:
第67章 护身符自燃-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

郭云涛焦急的声音从手机听筒里炸出来，令吴姜浑身一震，猛地从被窝里坐起身。

突如其来的动静吓了李月芽一跳，她下意识地摸向床头的开关，“咔哒”一声，房间里的灯瞬间亮起。

只是，下一秒，她的脸颊猛地一红，下意识地捂住眼睛，娇嗔着喊了一声：“呀！吴姜，你怎么把衣服脱了？”

嘴上喊着，手指照例闪了一道缝，偷偷欣赏起了吴姜棱角分明、线条流畅的身材，这家伙，现在的身材怎么这么好了？不行不行，不能想了，再想就要出事了！

李月芽赶紧甩了甩头，把脑子里那些涩涩的念头全甩出去，可吴姜此刻压根没心思搭理她。

“别慌！慢慢说，到底怎么回事？”

电话那头的郭云涛声音还带着未散的慌乱，语速快得像倒豆子：“我也不知道啊！我正打游戏呢，突然就觉得房间里一阵发凉，紧接着你送我的护身符在桌子上就开始冒烟，然后直接烧起来了！”

“我吓得魂都快飞了，赶紧跑我爸妈房间，结果发现他们的床头护身符也烧完了，这才赶紧给你打电话了。蛋子，你快问问画符的大师，这到底是啥情况啊？是不是有脏东西找上门了？”

吴姜没接他“找大师”的话茬，沉声道：“现在房间里还有没有那种阴冷的感觉？有没有其他不对劲的地方？”

“没有，家里现在一切正常！”

得知郭云涛说阴冷感已经消失，他才稍稍松了口气。

吴姜判断，应该是有邪祟闯进他们家了，只不过被他画的符箓惊走了。

能被他画的符纸吓退，级别肯定超不过厉鬼级。

为了防止邪祟卷土重来，吴姜想了一个办法，对着电话问道：“狗子，你们那边有没有城隍庙？”

郭云涛愣了两秒，连忙应声：“有！离我家不算太远，开车十几分钟就到了！”

“那就好。”吴姜稍微放松了些许，有城隍庙就好办了。

接着，吴姜就吩咐郭云涛，让他带着父母先去城隍庙避一避。

要是城隍庙关着门进不去，就在门口等着，先将就着在车里对付一夜，等天亮了再回家。

Guo Yuntao's anxious voice burst out from the receiver of the mobile phone, which shocked Wu Jiang and sat up from the bed suddenly.

The sudden movement startled Li Yueya. She subconsciously touched the switch on the bedside. With a click, the lights in the room instantly turned on.

However, the next second, her cheeks suddenly turned red, she subconsciously covered her eyes, and shouted coquettishly: "Ah! Wu Jiang, why did you take off your clothes?"

As he shouted, his fingers flashed a slit as usual, and he secretly admired Wu Jiang's angular and smooth figure. Why is this guy in such good shape now?No, no, no, I can’t think about it anymore, something will happen if I think about it again!

Li Yueya quickly shook her head to get rid of all the astringent thoughts in her mind, but Wu Jiang had no intention of paying attention to her at the moment.

"Don't panic! Tell me slowly, what's going on?"

Guo Yuntao's voice on the other end of the phone was still full of panic, and he spoke as fast as pouring beans: "I don't know either! I was playing games, and suddenly I felt a chill in the room. Then the amulet you gave me started to smoke on the table, and then it burned!"

"I was so scared that I almost flew out of my mind. I hurried to my parents' room, only to find that their bedside amulet was also burned, so I called you quickly. Danzi, please ask the master who drew the amulet, what is going on? Is there something dirty coming to the door?"

Wu Jiang did not answer his question about "finding the master" and said in a deep voice: "Is there still that cold feeling in the room now? Is there anything else wrong?"

"No, everything is normal at home now!"

He was slightly relieved when he learned that Guo Yuntao said that the cold feeling had disappeared.

Wu Jiang judged that an evil spirit must have broken into their home, but was frightened away by the talisman he drew.

If someone can be scared away by the talisman he drew, his level will definitely not exceed the level of a ghost.

In order to prevent the evil spirits from coming back, Wu Jiang thought of a way and asked on the phone: "Gouzi, do you have a City God's Temple over there?"

Guo Yuntao was stunned for two seconds and quickly responded: "Yes! It's not too far from my home, it only takes ten minutes to drive!"

"That's good." Wu Jiang relaxed a little, it would be easier if there was a Chenghuang Temple.

Then, Wu Jiang ordered Guo Yuntao to take his parents to the City God's Temple to take shelter.

If the door to the Chenghuang Temple is closed and you can't get in, just wait at the door, make do with it in the car all night, and then go home at dawn.
